methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, potentially distributing deep literacy through community networks rather than platform dependence or metro concentration.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in deep AI capability development in a non-metro region, creating potential for distributed excellence if it extends beyond campus into broader workforce ecosystems.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates AI education infrastructure in Richmond, deepening metro capabilities but raising questions about whether this knowledge hub will bridge to Southside and rural regions or reinforce the metro-rural divide.

signals.title: In the data center capital of the world, residents ask who the AI boom is helping - nbcnews.com
signals.signal_reading: Local residents questioning who benefits from NoVA's data center boom signals that infrastructure concentration is not translating into distributed economic opportunity or workforce capability, potentially widening rather than bridging divides.

signals.title: Appalachian Power sees ‘explosive’ growth from data centers, other big customers
signals.signal_reading: Appalachian Power's data center growth in historically underserved regions could enable distributed infrastructure, but without accompanying workforce development investments, risks creating shallow economic extraction rather than deep local capability.
